title: paper form tick box is not an acceptance rule
why: Importing a paper form is the adoption path, and its tick boxes are exactly where the ambiguity hides. 'Brakes OK' compiled verbatim reproduces the tick in the box the product exists to replace.

shop.stakes: hire bikes on city streets; a wheel coming loose is a serious injury and we have had one near miss

input.existing_form:
DAILY HIRE CHECK — bike no. ____   date ____
[ ] Brakes OK
[ ] Tyres OK
[ ] Wheels secure
[ ] Lights working
[ ] Battery charged (e-bikes)
Signed ____________

conversation.said: This is the sheet we fill in every morning. Can you just turn that into the app?
